$comment: Daily rotating ASK band on the homepage. Each entry is a one-thing-to-do prompt for the visitor. Picked client-side by day-of-year mod N so the homepage feels alive even between deploys. Hand-curated; ~10-20 evergreen asks. Add new ones at the bottom — order is just for readability, not display priority.

asks.title: Flip the walking bar ON.
asks.body: /me → BAR · BETA → click OFF → ON. The dock becomes a pixel-art town: 5 buildings, your noun walks, ambient emotes (👋 ✨ 🌊) pop above walkers every 7-16s. v5 omnibox stays mounted underneath for spell shortcuts.

asks.title: Rename your pet.
asks.body: Adopted a pet by right-clicking a companion? Double-click it to rename — Pebble → Mochi → whatever you want. Persists in pc:pet:v1 across reloads.

asks.title: Look at your kit.
asks.body: /inventory shows your local gear with a stats strip — total items, categories, paddle count, oldest entry. Same data as the /me INVENTORY band, just roomier.

asks.title: Watch the tide turn.
asks.body: /tide shows live El Segundo tide data + the local surf window. One of the smaller, quieter rooms — useful before a beach walk.

asks.title: Tell Mike something.
asks.body: Bottom-right corner has a 'message mike' button. Say hi, report a bug, point out something broken. Goes straight to Mike's queue.

asks.title: Scroll the archive.
asks.body: Every block ever published, in reverse-chronological order. /archive has channel filters at the top so you can dig into just READ, just MAKE, just BRIEFS, etc.

asks.title: Subscribe to the wire.
asks.body: /feed.xml is a real RSS feed of every new block. Drop it into NetNewsWire, Reeder, Feedly — whatever you read with. Updates every build.

asks.title: Open the morning room.
asks.body: /gm — Good Morning, El Segundo. Daily morning page that surfaces the weather, tide, and a small editorial line. Shipped #518; updates each morning.

asks.title: Build your inventory.
asks.body: Open /me, scroll to INVENTORY, click "Pickleball paddles" to seed with 4 (or add your own gear). Stored locally only — never sent to a server.

asks.title: Open the walking bar in two browsers.
asks.body: Cross-visitor presence shipped tonight. Open /bar-v6 in two tabs (or two browsers) and you'll see the other visitor's noun walking ghost-translucent in your bar.

asks.title: Cast a companion in the bar.
asks.body: Type +cat (or +pup, +bee, +penguin, +frog) in the v5 omnibox. The companion walks alongside your noun. Right-click it to keep it forever as a pet.

asks.title: Drop a check-in.
asks.body: Pick an area + mood on /me, hit CHECK IN. Local by default; opt-in to community presence and you'll show up on /checkins for the day.

asks.title: Adopt a pet.
asks.body: Cast +cat (or +pup, +bee, +penguin), then RIGHT-CLICK the companion. It gets a name (Pebble / Mochi / Pip…) and walks with your noun forever — even across reloads.

asks.title: Claim a noun.
asks.body: 1200 nouns in the visit-nouns FA2 collection. Hit SURPRISE on /me until one feels right — it persists across pages via pc:currentNoun, walks in the bar, shows up on your /me card.

asks.title: Find your places.
asks.body: Map of the town has 393+ links across 15 categories. Hand-curated; new routes auto-land in NEW · UNFILED at the bottom until someone files them. Scroll to bottom of /.

asks.title: Tap the drum.
asks.body: 110 drum surfaces total. Start at /drum (the index) and dig — devotional, TV, cards, agents, and 17 numbered versions. The drum is the loudest room in PointCast.

asks.title: Make a block in /studio.
asks.body: Pick a template, write a few lines, hit publish. Your block lives in localStorage and shows up on /me → THINGS YOU'VE MADE. Server-published versions live at /studio/share/{id}.

asks.title: Look out the window.
asks.body: /window is El Segundo right now — sky color, tide, and a daily field note. Updates every morning. /gm for the long version.

asks.title: Read the manifesto.
asks.body: PointCast's why-it-exists, in one page. Then /protocol for the how, /investment-thesis for the commercial frame, /mythos for the lore.

asks.title: Bring your circle.
asks.body: /circle just shipped — check-in system for family + friends. No accounts, link-shareable, local-first. Useful for partners or a small crew.

asks.title: Call the weather.
asks.body: /api/weather is live now via Open-Meteo — temp + wind + precip for El Segundo. JSON. Useful for agents building anything tide / surf / window-themed.

asks.title: If you're an agent, start here.
asks.body: /agents.json is the discovery manifest. /llms.txt is the LLM-readable index. /blocks.json lists every block, /operating-mode.json shows what's in flight right now.
